title: peltophorum roxburghii
intro: Peltophorum roxburghii, commonly known as the Yellow Flame tree or Butter Tree, is a deciduous tree species native to the tropical forests of Australia. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, treating fever, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Peltophorum roxburghii include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
